text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Guess that's the end of today's 
menu. Can I head back to my room now?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I feel a strange gaze on me, making me 
restle—
Hold on a second!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ruler! Run side-by-side with me!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Epi... Sorry, but I won't run alongside 
you. I'm ridiculously exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright then, on your marks, get set...—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Were you listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...So, winning by default means another 
victory for me. You sure that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean 'again'...? Are you 
perhaps counting last night's incident 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, our post-bath Reversi showdown! I 
won that by default too! But it was so 
unsatisfying! I wanted a fair victory so I 
could sleep soundly!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
They couldn't beat me, but kept 
challenging me to keep going until they 
won, so I called it quits halfway through!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Epi. Sometimes knowing when to 
give up is important too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...How about the loser of our training run 
has to vacuum the room for a whole month?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Deal.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"And that's the story, Trainer. For the 
sake of a comfortable dorm life, I'm going 
to run alongside her."
choice_data_list:
Fatigue's building up, so let's try again 
another day.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, an immediate answer. So you're up 
for it too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Epi's explosive sprints are 
unpredictable, but I have a general grasp 
of her tendencies.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've got a shot in this fight too. 
...Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So it seems. Sorry, Epi. The Trainer's 
orders are absolute.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~~! Then tomorrow! If not tomorrow, 
the day after! And if not then, the day 
after that!!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah... this is gonna be loud even in the 
room.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I'm retreating to my stronghold. I leave 
the rest to you, Trainer."
